description.value: The Vancouver Maritime Museum has occupied a scenic waterfront location in Vanier Park for over 60 years, focusing on the maritime history of the Pacific Northwest and the Arctic. Its flagship exhibit is the RCMP Vessel St. Roch, a National Historic Site sheltered in an iconic mid-century A-frame building, currently undergoing a major revitalization slated for Winter 2026/2027. The museum also stewards Heritage Harbour and the Blue Cabin, making it a multi-site cultural destination steps from the Seawall cycling route.
